title: 🏗️ Reston VA Engineering Jobs - Multiple Nuclear & RF Roles Up to $220K - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Reston’s engineering scene is busy right now—especially around nuclear power, RF systems, and federal projects. If you’ve got architecture/engineering skills, there are several solid roles with clear growth paths and strong pay.
Lead Mechanical Engineer 1 – Nuclear Employer: Sargent & Lundy Location: Reston, VA Type: Full-time Salary: $118,023 – $180,313 Lead nuclear power plant system design work: modification packages, mechanical drawings, analyses, specs, and vendor evaluations. Great fit if you have 10+ years in power , strong nuclear codes/standards knowledge, and want to lead project teams and visit client sites.
Senior Mechanical Engineer 1 – Nuclear Employer: Sargent & Lundy Location: Reston, VA Type: Full-time Salary: $84,762 – $129,498 Design and support mechanical systems for operating nuclear plants, from analyses and system drawings to spec writing and equipment bid reviews. Designed for engineers with 5+ years in the power industry who want more client-facing work and team-lead opportunities .
Senior Mechanical Designer 1 – Nuclear Power Employer: Sargent & Lundy Location: Reston, VA Type: Full-time Salary: $77,890 – $118,999 Own the 3D mechanical layout for nuclear projects: piping, supports, equipment locations, and general arrangements. Ideal if you’ve got 10+ years of detailed plant design , strong 3D modeling skills, and like acting as the design team lead .
Senior Electrical Designer 1 – Nuclear Power Employer: Sargent & Lundy Location: Reston, VA Type: Full-time Salary: $77,890 – $118,999 Create and refine electrical design drawings for nuclear projects using tools like MicroStation, with chances to join field walkdowns and explain your designs to vendors and contractors. Best for designers with 10+ years of drafting/design and strong CAD skills.
Senior License Renewal Implementation Professional 1 – Nuclear Employer: Sargent & Lundy Location: Reston, VA Type: Full-time Salary: $84,762 – $129,498 Turn license renewal (LR/SLR) and aging management commitments into real inspection plans and work orders across the U.S. nuclear fleet. Great if you have 5+ years in nuclear/industrial/DOE facilities , know work management systems, and like blending field reality with regulatory requirements .
License Renewal Implementation Consultant 2 – Nuclear Employer: Sargent & Lundy Location: Reston, VA Type: Full-time Salary: $145,310 – $222,001 A more senior LR/SLR role doing similar work— aging management programs, NRC commitments, inspection planning , and coordination with schedulers and field teams. Targeted to seasoned pros with 10+ years in nuclear/DOE/industrial facilities and deep experience in license renewal and NRC-facing work .
Environmental Project Manager I Employer: HydroGeoLogic, Inc. (HGL) Location: Reston, VA (in-office) Type: Full-time Salary: $96,480 – $144,720 Manage CERCLA/RCRA remediation projects for EPA, U.S. Army Corps, and other agencies—budgets, schedules, technical reports, and field teams. Great if you have 4+ years on federal cleanup projects , strong writing skills, and want to grow in environmental project leadership ; U.S. citizenship required .
Senior Field Applications Engineer – RF Employer: Motorola Solutions (CRFS) Location: Reston, VA (hybrid) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Be the technical bridge between cutting-edge RF spectrum products and customers—training, field deployments, troubleshooting, and sales support, with up to 50% travel . Best for RF-focused engineers with 5+ years’ experience , strong test gear skills, and U.S. citizenship .
